summary: Independent targeted testing of integrated commit c96d13f passed the reveal lifecycle, reduced-motion paths, finished-SaaS copy, build, responsive overflow, scroll-performance trace, all staff routes, and complete Maria/caregiver journey, but the visible mobile workspace-dock controls measure about 38.25 by 38.25 pixels at 320px and 390px viewports instead of the approved 44px minimum.

commands: cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/smoke.test.ts tests/component.test.tsx tests/continuity-field.test.tsx tests/scroll-reveal.test.tsx
cd frontend && PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=4174 npx playwright test tests/e2e.spec.ts

cd frontend && node --input-type=module -e '<Playwright audit: 320x568, 390x844, 768x1024, and 1440x900 overflow/document-scroll, user reduced motion, FAQ, static map fallback, patient workspace reachability, and mobile dock geometry>'
cd frontend && node --input-type=module -e '<Playwright production scroll trace: full 1440x900 wheel pass with PerformanceObserver long-task collection>'
python3 scripts/agentctl.py scope check UI-001 tester
tests.notes: Vitest passed 4 files and 14 tests with no skips. TypeScript passed. The production build passed after transforming 8,481 modules in 3m42s. Isolated-port Playwright passed 3/3: SaaS/reveal/overflow, OS reduced motion, and all eight staff destinations plus the complete Maria journey, caregiver DOM exclusion, and reset. Additional production-browser measurement found scrollWidth equal to clientWidth at 320, 390, 768, and 1440; document-owned workspace scrolling; immediate labeled map fallback; user motion-off final states with no pending reveal, transform, or smooth behavior; and no PerformanceObserver long tasks during a full 1440x900 landing wheel pass. The same measurement found every visible mobile dock control at approximately 38.25x38.25px at both mobile widths. A first default-port Playwright attempt reached an unrelated already-running stale preview and produced 2 failures/1 pass; the required isolated-port rerun against the freshly built c96d13f artifact passed 3/3.

blockers.description: At 320x568 and 390x844, Home, Patient, Staff, Caregiver, and Graph buttons in the fixed mobile Workspace dock each render at about 38.25x38.25px. UI-001 requires 44px minimum public/patient/mobile targets, so the dock misses the approved responsive-accessibility boundary.
blockers.suggestion: Increase the mobile DockTarget hit area to an explicit minimum of 44x44px without changing the compact icon size, then rerun the responsive overflow/coverage audit and the full targeted suite.

notes_for_next_agent: Retest the exact corrected integrated commit; do not carry forward this commit-bound result as passing evidence.
Preserve the current no-overflow result at 320 and 390 while enlarging all five mobile dock hit areas, and confirm the fixed dock still leaves the last workspace controls reachable.

The shared ScrollReveal implementation already passed observer one-time unobserve, focus completion, no-observer fallback, distinct patient/staff/caregiver variants, and reduced-motion final-state assertions.
Landing copy and the four-part SaaS model passed the forbidden identity-term audit; all staff routes, Maria persistence/reset flow, and caregiver clinical/nurse-detail exclusion passed on c96d13f.
